the question of how a field for a sustainable technology is created.
how conferences can be used to create a field for solar energy technology in a context that is especially challenging for the development of the technology.
the role of conferences in the emergence and development of fields for sustainable technologies.

the field-configuring conferences in this case study have served as a sequential arena for creating new sustainable fields.
conferences are fruitful for the creation of sustainable fields, as long as the conferences are well designed, and that they are especially fruitful for creating fields in challenging contexts.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the conference sequence was an intervention that triggered processes that were both disruptive and incremental, and that these processes, in turn, generated further disruptive and incremental processes.

the conference sequence in this study was able to serve as an arena for creating the field for a new solar technology, and that this was achieved by a sequence of conferences that were designed to trigger processes that were able to address the two different aspects of field creation simultaneously.

the conferences in this case served as arenas for field configuration, where a community of practitioners, researchers and other stakeholders could gather and engage in processes of field configuration.
The main takeaway from our work is that
conferences can be designed and used to create new sustainable fields.
conference organizers can use the conference format to promote the innovation and, at the same time, create steppingstones for systemic change.
conferences are not just arenas for knowledge sharing and socialization, they can also be seen as arenas for creating new fields.
